data.rationale: The proposal follows the same navigation sequence (Find a Park, Search by Activity or Topic, expand dropdown, choose options, Search) and parameterizes filter type and options. It omits the optional state parameter and is vague on how to select options ("check checkboxes"), and the parameter names don't match the true ones, so an automation would need some guesswork.
